items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I'll be doing that within this month sometime, some way. Around and about Brown and Bryant and Wayne Cochran.

ctx.x: When do you envision the album that you're doing coming up?
Well, I'm going to do four sides first. So I'll be doing that within this month sometime, some way. Around and about Brown and Bryant and Wayne Cochran.
Mm-hmm. Or somebody asked me if you'd have the thematic piece sail on on your new album.
